title: Icon box
description: Icon, title and text.

title: Icon box (side)
description: Icon on the left of the text.

title: Image box
description: Image with title and text.

title: Message box
description: Highlighted note with an icon.

title: Price table
description: Plan, price, features and a button.

title: Testimonial
description: Quote with avatar, name and role.

title: Team member
description: Photo, name, role and follow icons.

title: Tabs
description: Panels shown one at a time. Each panel's first heading is its tab. Without JavaScript they stack, still readable.

title: Gallery
description: Image grid; on the published page a click opens the image large (arrows, Esc). Swap the images in Content.

title: Search
description: The site's search box (WordPress search block).

title: Product search
description: Search box that looks only through products.

title: Banner
description: Background image, overlay and a text box. Fits in a column.

title: Stat
description: Big number with a label.

title: Counter
description: Numbers that count up when they scroll into view. Change the numbers like any text.

title: Progress bars
description: Labelled bars that fill when they scroll into view. Set each fill's width in Style.

title: Star rating
description: Five stars and a score. Delete a star or tint it to show less.

title: Icon list
description: Short lines, each with an icon: benefits, what is included, contact details.

title: Notice
description: A highlighted message: an announcement, a tip or a warning.

title: Map
description: A Google map of an address (no API key). Set the address in Content.

title: Breadcrumbs
description: Home › Section › Page, with structured data for search engines.

title: Logo (text)
description: Wordmark; replace with an image when ready.

title: Follow icons
description: Social icons row.

title: Button group
description: Primary and secondary buttons.

title: Title + divider
description: Section title with a line.

title: Accordion
description: Collapsible question and answer.

title: Video
description: Responsive YouTube/Vimeo embed.

title: Feature cards
description: Three bordered cards with an icon, a title and a line; 3 → 2 → 1 columns.

title: Pricing
description: Three tiers, the middle one emphasised with a token colour.

title: Testimonial
description: A quote with its author in one bordered card.

title: Stats
description: Four numbers with labels; 4 → 2 columns.

title: FAQ
description: Three accordions with one-line answers.

title: Product card
description: One product: picture, name, price, discount and a link to the product. Put it in a Products loop.

title: Header bar
description: Logo, the site's menu (a button on tablets and phones), search, account and cart.

title: Shop icons
description: Search (desktop), language, account and cart.

title: Top bar
description: Tagline, language and sign in in one thin line; hidden on phones.

title: Footer columns
description: Logo and tagline, then three columns of links; 2 on tablets, 1 on phones.

title: Footer last line
description: Copyright and follow icons.

title: Phone bar
description: Home, search, cart and account at the bottom of a phone's screen (phones only).

title: Header bar
description: Logo, the site's menu (a button on tablets and phones) and search.

title: Shop header bar
description: Logo, menu, search, account and the mini cart.

title: Footer columns
description: Site title and tagline, then three columns of links.

title: Footer last line
description: Copyright and follow icons.

title: Store header (3 rows)
description: Top bar, then logo, search and shop icons, then the menu under a line (Flatsome's header rows).

title: Top bar
description: A thin dark line: a message on the left, links on the right; hidden on phones.

title: Logo
description: The site logo.

title: Site title
description: The site's name, linked to the home page.

title: Menu
description: The site's menu; a button on tablets and phones.

title: Search icon
description: A search button that opens a field.

title: Account
description: Sign in / my account link.

title: Cart
description: The mini cart with its count.

title: Wishlist
description: Wishlist link with its count (Auvyx Woo).

title: Contact line
description: A phone icon and number.

title: Follow icons
description: Facebook, Instagram, YouTube.

title: Phone bar
description: Home, search, cart and account at the bottom of a phone's screen (phones only).

title: Countdown
description: Days, hours, minutes and seconds to a sale's end. Set the end in Content; it counts on the published page.

title: Popup
description: Opens over the page: after a few seconds, on exit, on scroll or from a link to #newsletter-popup. Set when and how often in Content.

title: Banner — left
description: Text box on the left of the photo.

title: Banner — right
description: Text box on the right of the photo.

title: Banner — box left
description: Copy on a light panel over the photo.

title: Banner — huge sale
description: One big sale headline.

title: Hotspot
description: A dot on a banner photo that shows a product card. Drop it on a Banner, then drag it into place.

title: Shop the look
description: A photo with product hotspots (Flatsome lookbook).

title: Slider
description: Banners that slide (or fade). Each slide is a Banner; settings in Content → Slider.

title: Table of contents
description: Lists the page's headings with links to them, built on the published page.

title: Share buttons
description: Share this page on Facebook, X, LinkedIn or WhatsApp, or copy its link.

title: Flip box
description: A card that turns over on hover (a tap on phones): the front, then the back with a button.

title: Before / after
description: Two images and a handle to compare them. Use two photos of the same size.

title: Marquee
description: A strip of words or logos that scrolls sideways, without end. Pauses under the pointer.

title: Course card
description: Cover, tag, title, rating, price and button.

title: Webinar card
description: Navy card with tag, speaker, title and shapes.

title: Mentor card
description: Portrait with a gradient and name.

title: Promo card
description: Navy offer card with geometric tiles.

title: Product card — editorial
description: Photo, New-in tag, uppercase name, price (bound to the product).

title: Product card — maison
description: Framed photo, category, serif name, price, outlined button.

title: Course card
description: One course: a photograph, subject and level, length, rating, price and Enrol.

title: Subject tile
description: One subject in a ruled cell, with its course count set large.

title: Mentor row
description: One mentor: the name in capitals, the day job and the subject.

title: Review card
description: One review in a ruled cell, with the learner's name and role.

title: Product card — Classic
description: Photo on a tile, category, name, stars and price; the second photo on hover; heart, compare and quick view over the photo.

title: Product card — Minimal
description: Centered name and price under a bare photo that zooms on hover.

title: Product card — Icons on hover
description: Wishlist, compare and quick view slide in over the photo; an add to cart link under the price.

title: Product card — Add to cart bar
description: A full-width add to cart bar slides up over the photo on hover (always shown on touch screens).

title: Product card — Quick buy
description: Options as swatches, quantity and add to cart inside the card, for buying from the grid.

title: Product card — Photo slider
description: Every product photo in the card, with arrows and dots; outlined add to cart.

title: Product card — List
description: Photo beside the name, stars, price, summary, swatches and buttons: for list views and sidebars.

title: Product card — Deal
description: Compact card with a countdown to the end of the sale and a sold / available bar.

title: Product card — Bordered
description: Framed card with a row of badges, color swatches and a full-width button.

title: Product card — Caption on photo
description: Tall photo with the name and price over a shade at the bottom: editorial.
